title: Threads coming together
description: Moving highlights trace three measured paths into a shared destination.
useCase: Explain aggregation, integrations or a simple flow of information.
reducedMotion: The SVG timeline freezes at a representative point; the full connection diagram remains visible.
limitations: Uses native SVG animation and ResizeObserver. This illustrates connections; it does not track actual task completion.
look: Pale sage page with three small off-white rounded nodes on the left joined by thin grey curves to one larger dark olive rounded tile.
motion: A short gold-to-green gradient highlight travels along each curved connector toward the target every 4 s with a strong ease-out spline, the three beams offset by 0.7 s, looping indefinitely.
adapt: `updatePath` measures node centres into quadratic paths (re-run by `ResizeObserver`); each beam is a `linearGradient` whose `x1`/`x2` are driven by SVG `animate` (`dur` 4s, `begin` offset `i * 0.7`). Replace the node labels and the `#d6be80`/`#849f6a` stops.
